name: ECA: Google
description: Google API integration services for ECA.
project_description: ECA: Google is the base module of a suite that lets ECA (Event-Condition-Action) models call Google APIs. It ships no ECA plugins of its own; instead it provides a shared authentication/service-resolution layer (the eca_google.google_api service) and reusable action-config traits that the service submodules build on. Authentication is delegated to the Google API Client (google_api_client) module, supporting both OAuth2 API-client entities and Service Account entities; an action selects one via an 'auth_type:client_id' string. Enable the matching service submodule (currently ECA: Google Sheets) for the Google service you want to automate.
